lightweight_all_thread_sync.rule: Independent connector read at exact head; repeat HEAD read after retrieval. Never infer another thread completed sync from a published projection.
lightweight_all_thread_sync.partial: Document noncompromising limitations and explicit T1-G2 waiver; identity/pin/authority/fence/hash mismatch cannot be waived.

semantic_cross_validation.scope: Dependency closure of read_set/write_set, shared objects/interfaces, provenance edges and explicitly declared boundary requests; do not scan unrelated full peer workspaces.
semantic_cross_validation.dependency_closure: Expand referenced claims/objects/interfaces plus required provenance one hop; expand further when necessary. Undeclared discovered dependencies require declaration and new validation.
semantic_cross_validation.exact_refs: repository, commit, path, record_selector, sha256; no conversation assertions as persistent authority.
semantic_cross_validation.unaccepted_worker_assertions: Candidate claims only; never authoritative peer state.
semantic_cross_validation.conflict_rule: Preserve parallel states and OPEN boundaries; semantic agreement is not forced.
semantic_cross_validation.master_global_gate: All active instances lightweight sync plus dependency-scoped validation of every proposed integrated delta; all required accepted returns plus explicit user Commence remain mandatory.

legacy_return_handling: Unchanged in Phase8A; schema presence does not authorize execution, acceptance or integration.
